summary: verdaccio-okta-oauth preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is variable-name-obfuscated and, on npm install, detects platform/arch/musl, downloads a matching Bun runtime zip from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and then execFileSyncs the dropped Bun binary against `math_init.js` sitting in the package root. `math_init.js` is a single-line ~727KB obfuscator.io-style blob (string-array rotator `WV8StW`, large numeric constants array `n7gIxM`, decoder `hc1jfK9`) shipped with no source form. A Verdaccio Okta OAuth plugin has no functional need for the Bun runtime or an opaque 727KB sibling script; fetching an alternate interpreter specifically to execute an opaque payload at preinstall runs arbitrary attacker-controlled code on the installer's machine and evades Node-scoped inspection.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
